decision_question: Does the initial outcome-modeling family merit an analytical structural-integrity handoff while live evaluation remains pending?

candidate.hash_scope: Core package decision artifacts at the final validation point.

shared_model_or_source_limits: The review was performed in one authoring context.
No isolated executor, independent reviewer, or unseen holdout owner was available.

claims.claim: The family has a coherent portable core, narrow adapters, safety boundaries, and evidence-design records.
claims.consequence: A missing separation would cause domain-objective or authorization errors.
assumptions: Structural inspection is sufficient for this analytical finding.

disruptor.reason: No independent multi-reviewer context was available, so the conditional disruptor protocol was not run.

unresolved_items: Live with-skill and without-skill task evaluation is not run.
An unseen release holdout is external-required.
Discovery precision and recall have not been measured in target clients.

limitations: This record supports analytical structural integrity only.
It does not claim performance, uplift, production readiness, or independent approval.
The recorded hash covers SKILL.md, evals/evals.json, and benchmarks/benchmark.json; the review record and learning ledger are excluded to avoid circular hashing.
follow_up_conditions: Run matched version-specific tasks with and without each adapter or the selected family route.
Use an external owner for an unseen release holdout.
Run discovery tests across supported clients before promoting the family beyond draftable maturity.
